name: GLANSIT KYOTO KAWARAMACHI
detail: I booked the superior capsule and it's the best capsule I had so far in Japan. Unlike most capsule, I don't need to check out of my room if I stay for multiple nights here and there's also option to choose for cleaning service for the superior capsule (no extra charges). It's like a mini hotel room with your own desk and door and bed... but without a lock. To me that's good enough because the price is great! Bed wise is very comfortable, not too noisy with a huge TV screen. It's comparable to a sky suite. Locker is huge enough for you to put your luggage in as well as your bags and others items (you have upper and lower storage space in the locker). The capsule although within about 5-10 mins walk from train station, its location is great as situated opposite Takashimaya and the most happening street in Kyoto and next to Gion. I will definitely come back here again to stay if I want save some costs on my accommodation in Kyoto and yet comfortable enough.

name: Livemax Hostels Kyoto Ekimae
detail: Great location excellent price and amazing service

name: RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto
detail: It is also very near Kyoto Station and other tourist sites

name: The Millennials Kyoto
detail: This is the only capsule hotel in Kyoto that has a mixed floor, meaning a floor for both guy & girl which is convenient for a couple like us travelling as we don't want to be on different floor for the night. The room is just a bed with all the remote & key being the Ipod that was passed to you during check in. The troublesome thing is to make sure the ipod is fully charged at all time if not, it will affect on how you can control the light, air & stuffs. There is a place for everyone to mingle & eat. Cups & plates are also provided but do remember to do your own washing once you are done.

name: Hotel Elcient Kyoto Hachijoguchi
detail: Specifically booked this hotel due to its proximity to Kyoto Station. Just across the road in fact. Was pleasantly surprised that it is not only near to Kyoto Station, but it is also situated on the JR station side, which means we do not have to walk the length of the station to get to the Shinkansen station to Tokyo. Best located (for my purpose) hotel for me and my small family. There is a kimono rental shop just at the entrance and the selection was small but very beautiful. I personally did not rent from there but from what I can observed, it is a convenient place to start for your kimono experience. They charged around 3900 yen when I was there. There is a small Lawson right across the street from the hotel, in case you came back late from your excursion and in need of refreshment. The shops at Kyoto Station generally close at 10PM. name: APA Hotel Kyoto Ekihigashi
detail: Clean place, breakfast is ok, no free parking lots and to park overnight for public place is so expensive. Onsen is free and private. There is washing machine, hotel is clean and new condition. There are 7-11 and Lawson close by. The place is close to Kyoto tower and Isetan and Kyoto station. Totally is ok for spending money here.

name: KANSEI Kyoto Hachijo
detail: The room was excellent! Very clean, updated and comfortable.

name: Ryokan Nihonkan Hotel
detail: At first I was worried about need to rush back ryokan before 11pm is impossible , then I realize that this ryokan is very near Kyoto station , u only pass the Porta Dinning Basement Walk and go straight , you will reach. Beside this , I also can't used to bath in front of everyone ( same sex ) , but then I try to persuade myself to accept Japanese bathroom style and I LOVE IT ! The bathtub water is very comfort ! The staff also very helpful ! The room was big and Tatami was fine ! I saw some bad review about this ryokan , and worries about that , but that is definitely wrong . My sister and I very enjoy to stay at this Ryokan . Definitely will come back here if we visit Kyoto again !

name: Continue Nijojo Kita
detail: Great hotel for the price, hard to complain about anything.

name: Hotel Hokke Club Kyoto
detail: Pros: Superb location, I came out from Kyoto metro station towards Kyoto tower direction, straightaway saw it on the left hand side of Kyoto tower. Very clean and nicely decorated with quality amenities hotel room. I stayed in the single non smoking room but the room was provided with a queen size bed that can fit two adults (Of course I don’t mean oversized adults). It’s spacious enough to have a small single sofa, small round table and a stool inside the room. Definitely more spacious than most Kyoto hotel room. Nearby there’re numerous nice food stalls or restaurants. Transport wise is definitely a big plus as there are many buses going to tourist attractions. Kyoto metro station is right in front of the hotel. Hotel lobby is at level 2. Level 1 has a nice cafe provided good coffee. Didn’t have chance to eat the breakfast but should be good since the coffee smells good. I will definitely come back again if I come to Kyoto! Cons: no.
